reuse.why: Reuses getBudgetData, getSheetValue, setBudget, getCategoryAverage and the undoable/mutator registration, and builds one selection function that every month-wide action now uses.

duplication.why: The four copied category queries are collapsed into getMonthWideCategories, but the income-in-tracking check stays repeated per action, the goal_def/notes join appears in both getBudgetData and getMonthWideCategories, and setLastMonthSpending re-writes the expense sign flip inline.

placement.why: The exclusion predicate and selection live in budget/actions.ts beside the actions that use them, and the new method is registered in budget/app.ts with the other budget methods.

scope.why: Edits are limited to the month-wide actions, the new method registration, one test and release notes.

maintainability.why: Adding a further exclusion rule now means editing one predicate (as steps 3 and 4 did); the remaining per-action income check and inline sign flip are minor seams.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions (copyPreviousMonth via isSkippedByMonthWideAction, the others via getMonthWideCategories) use the shared exclusion rule.

disguised_duplication.where: The only repeated logic (income check, sign flip) is written openly in the same form as the existing actions, not reshaped.

abstraction_drift.where: includeHiddenCategories added to isSkippedByMonthWideAction and getMonthWideCategories for the requested variation; the #fixed rule was added as a plain clause of the predicate and no action bypasses it.
